sections: Coupling the distance, lease, and supply budgets

blocks.md: This lesson covers the book's section on **The Handoffs Matrix**. Read the excerpt, then test yourself below.

blocks.source: Vol IV, The Nervous System, § The Handoffs Matrix
blocks.md: When a mobile manipulator overruns a stop, the diagnosis begins by locating the fault at one of five canonical handoffs between the photons collected by its cameras and the current delivered to its drives. A cloud service governs its interfaces with statistical service-level objectives (SLOs), such as a $\text{p99}$ request latency; when a tail event violates that target, the runtime absorbs the delay through retries, request rerouting, or graceful degradation. The five handoffs of an embodied machine define **hard cyber-physical service-level objectives** instead.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Chunk lease matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: An admitted chunk may drive the actuators only for a lease counted on the permission path's own clock, derived from the plant: longer than the renewal period plus jitter and short enough to fit under the pre-brake ceiling of the stopping budget.

questions.q: The section **The Handoffs Matrix** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: An admitted chunk may drive the actuators only for a lease counted on the permission path's own clock, derived from the plant: longer than the renewal period plus jitter and short enough to fit under the pre-brake ceiling of the stopping budget.

The level at which a proposal enters the drive's position-velocity-current cascade decides what the permission path must verify, from geometry for a position target to integrated motion for a velocity target.
Whether every axis exchanges command and feedback within the bus cycle is a necessary check computed from frame geometry, but occupancy alone is not a response bound.

The permission path must be the sole writer of every electrical path that can energize a winding, because one unmediated write puts proposer and drives in one failure domain, and the stop itself must be specified in hardware.

questions.explanation: This section develops **Chunk lease**: An admitted chunk may drive the actuators only for a lease counted on the permission path's own clock, derived from the plant: longer than the renewal period plus jitter and short enough to fit under the pre-brake ceiling of the stopping budget.
